howto: Tap your age, type your name if you like, then press Start playing.
Keep Pip happy: tap Feed, Fetch and Nap when the love, food or energy meters get low.
Do Tricks, play Games (Star Catch, Paw Match, Homework, Bible Quiz, Memory Verse) and grow the Garden to earn stars.
Spend stars in the Shop on outfits, pets and scenes, and finish the daily quests for bonus stars.
tips: Pip's meters drop slowly even while you are away, so feed Pip first when you come back.
Tap Pip for a quick bit of love and a bond point.
In Star Catch, five catches in a row give a bonus; tapping a cloud resets the streak.
The 🎁 gift is ready once a day: come back tomorrow to grow your streak.
Homework questions match the age you picked; change it in Settings > Age.

controls.keyboard: Tab to any button and press Enter or Space (Pip can be patted with Enter too). P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap the buttons, Pip and the garden plots; drag furniture in your room.

difficulty: Age bands (Ages 4–6, 7–9, 10–12 and 13+) set how hard the Homework questions are and how many stars they pay; pick one on the title card or in Settings > Age.

cheats.effect: Love, food and energy all filled to the top
No clouds fall in Star Catch

features.autosave: Everything saves as you play (claire_pip_save_v2), and Pip's needs catch up with the time you were away
features.goals-or-quests: 📋 Quests: three new tasks every day with star rewards and a bonus for finishing all three; 🏆 achievements
features.day-time-ui: The meadow follows the real time of day (day and night sky) with a weather badge; 🎁 has a daily calendar
features.inventory: 📔 Collection shows outfits, pets, scenes and stickers collected; the Shop wardrobe holds what you own
features.results: Star Catch ends with a Time's up card (stars, best, Play again); Paw Match ends with an All matched card
features.tutorial: Four coach marks after Start playing (Pip's needs, care buttons, quests and the shop) that leave every button tappable; replay from How to play
